name: Qing Yao
summary: I research speech enhancement with diffusion models, turning noisy recordings into clear, natural sound.
role: PhD Student in Speech & Audio Processing
bio: Hi, I'm Qing Yao, a Ph.D. student at Jiangsu University. My research focuses on **generative speech enhancement**, aiming to achieve high-fidelity speech reconstruction through efficient generative modeling.

I explore two complementary directions: **continuous diffusion models**, particularly Schrödinger bridges, operating in the complex-valued time–frequency domain, and **discrete masked diffusion models** operating on acoustic tokens extracted from neural audio codecs.

Motivated by the ill-posed nature of speech enhancement, I seek to develop generative approaches that reconcile reconstruction fidelity, perceptual naturalness, and computational efficiency, while improving generalization across diverse acoustic conditions.

education.description: Research in diffusion-based generative modeling and speech enhancement.
